DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, nothing was agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an explanation of why it was entered before anyone called her, and your offer in writing; the fair outcome is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under 4.4, but she never got evidence to justify moving there, and her time had not run out.
What moved her: You told her the rewrite would replace the zero and leave his record clean, which met her fallback demand and got a flat acknowledgment, but with no evidence behind it that was all it could do.
What cost ground: You offered the rewrite before showing anything about the essay, and she read that as a request to accept something without being told what for, so she held her ground.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because you showed none, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asks why Owen has a zero, answer that first with one dated thing she can check yourself, and own in a sentence that the zero went in before you called, before you bring up the rewrite.
